comparison.objective: Fold eyeglass temples and close the glasses inside a hard case; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential articulation of delicate hinges, placement, and case closure, not hammer impact or small-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Temples folded, glasses enclosed, and case closed; hinge, alignment, damage, and latch thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: This tests articulated folding and packaging, not force-triggered break-off and recovery.
